$comment: The blog index. Every post listed here must have a matching Markdown file at site/blog/posts/<slug>.md. Fields: slug (kebab-case, becomes the URL ?p=<slug>), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), tags (array, free-form, drives the filter row), summary (one or two sentences shown on the card and in the RSS feed), and the optional reading (minutes, an integer; omitted means it is estimated from the file). Set draft: true to keep a post out of the index and the feed while you write it. Newest first is not required — the index sorts by date. See posts/_template.md.
